name: aigent-talking-head
summary: Turn a phone clip into a captioned, styled 9:16 talking-head reel, locally.
invoke: npm run <command> -- <args>  (from the repo root; or node <script> <args>)

types.boolean: a flag with no value; present means true
types.number: a numeric value after the flag
types.path: a file or folder path, relative to the current folder unless noted

env.name: PYTHON
env.description: Python that has requirements.txt installed (default python3, or py on Windows)

env.name: CHROME_PATH
env.description: Chrome or Chromium binary when it is not found automatically

env.name: TX_MODEL
env.description: Whisper model clip.py uses when reel gets no --model (default large-v3)

env.name: NOSFX
env.description: 1 turns off sounds in reel and fx (same as --sfx off)

env.name: FX_MATTE
env.description: person-mask backend for fx when no --mask is given

env.name: FX_WSL
env.description: Windows only: Python inside WSL that runs the effects

env.name: FX_WSL_DISTRO
env.description: Windows only: the WSL distro for FX_WSL

env.name: REA_VIDEO
env.description: path to the rea-video binary for teardown

env.name: FREESOUND_API_KEY
env.description: only for searching new sounds; nothing else needs a key

graphics.where: a reel-graphics block in a Reel.md (one line per graphic: #NN start-end | type <id> | field value ...), or captions.js flips with the mode
rules: fields under spoken must be words you say in the graphic's window; a recipe job drops the rest (kit/spoken.cjs)
layer behind puts the graphic under the crown mask: only the top of your head goes over it, never your face or chin

types.summary: list number sticker: an italic serif word (FIRST, SECOND, NEXT) over a spiky starburst; the burst can sit behind your head
app or logo label: a square icon tile and a bold label with a white outline; your icon image, or a generic glyph
screen card: a rounded dark card with a coloured border, inset in the lower middle, showing your screenshot or screen recording
lower third name tag: an accent bar wipes up, then a plate slides out with your name and a small line under it
big number callout: the number counts up to its value in the accent colour, a label rises under it
checklist card: rows drop in, and each box ticks as you say its item
quote card: big quote marks pop, the line fades in word by word in an italic serif, with a small attribution under it
hand-drawn highlight: a circle, arrow, underline or box draws itself on, with an optional short label at its tail
step counter: a pill with STEP 2 OF 5 and a segmented progress bar that fills to the current step
versus card: two halves slide in from the sides and a VS badge slams between them
round icon badge: spins in while its ring draws round; a built-in glyph or your icon, with an optional label pill
reaction stickers: a little cluster of die-cut stickers (hearts, stars, fire, sparks) pops in around a point and floats up
price tag: a tag drops in on a string and swings to rest, the price big on it and an old price struck through above
call-to-action end card: a card rises with your line and handle, and a follow button pulses
code snippet card: an editor window with line numbers, the code typing itself on in a monospace face with light syntax colour

commands.name: reel
commands.summary: Phone clip (or several takes) to a draft reel: clip, cut, captions, titles, render, assemble.

positional.name: videos
positional.description: takes to use; default is every video from the newest recording session in inbox/

flags.name: clip
flags.description: the video to use (same as a positional path)

flags.name: clips
flags.description: reuse an existing clip.py folder and skip transcription

flags.name: newest
flags.description: inbox: newest file only

flags.name: name
flags.description: job name under jobs/

flags.name: jobs
flags.description: jobs folder

flags.name: preset
flags.description: a preset name from npm run preset, or auto

flags.name: recipe
flags.description: a Reel.md recipe (docs/reel-md.md)

flags.name: recipe-titles
flags.description: use the recipe's title text and times, only where you say that text

flags.name: capture-sources
flags.description: capture the recipe's confirmed screen-card sources first (public pages)

flags.name: theme
flags.description: a theme in kit/themes/ (aigent, neutral, or your own)

flags.name: style
flags.description: caption style override

flags.name: titles
flags.description: force kinetic titles on

flags.name: no-titles
flags.description: no kinetic titles

flags.name: fonts
flags.description: font pairing names from kit/fonts/pairings.json or kit/fonts/local; several cycle one per title

flags.name: caption-layer
flags.default: auto for top captions, front otherwise
flags.description: captions under the person where they overlap the head; auto puts top captions behind

flags.name: panel-layer
flags.description: screen cards behind the head where it reaches into them; auto means behind

flags.name: mask
flags.description: person-mask backend for titles behind the head

flags.name: no-mask
flags.description: skip the person mask

flags.name: no-punch
flags.description: no zoom punch on cuts

flags.name: cropx
flags.description: horizontal crop centre, 0 to 1 (0.4 puts the face left of centre)

flags.name: model
flags.description: Whisper model for clip.py

flags.name: hook
flags.description: take to use for the first sentence

flags.name: broll
flags.description: folder of your own cutaway clips

flags.name: bed
flags.description: a bed name from npm run music, or an audio file path

flags.name: bed-start
flags.description: seconds into the bed to start

flags.name: beat-sync
flags.description: snap punches, sounds, titles and fx hits to the bed (on by default when a bed is set)

flags.name: finish
flags.description: film finishes

flags.name: logo
flags.description: logo file for the end card

flags.name: sfx
flags.description: off skips the locked-set sounds

flags.name: no-sfx
flags.description: same as --sfx off

flags.name: draft
flags.description: stop after captions.js so it can be edited

flags.name: rebuild
flags.description: re-render and re-assemble an edited job (use with --name)

flags.name: force
flags.description: re-clip and redraft over an existing job

outputs: jobs/<name>/clips/clips.json and clips.md (best take per sentence, retakes flagged)
jobs/<name>/build/cut.json, captions.js, theme.js and overlay frames
jobs/<name>/reel-vN.mp4 (a new number each run; earlier versions are kept)
failures: No video given and inbox/ has none
build/cut.json exists: use --rebuild to render edits or --force to redraft
an invalid enum value: "--<flag> must be ..."

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: Check a finished reel before handing it over: ffprobe, loudness, mask, copy lint and stills.

positional.name: job
positional.description: job name in jobs/ (or a job folder path)

flags.name: file
flags.default: newest reel-fx-vN.mp4 or reel-vN.mp4 in the job
flags.description: the video to check

flags.name: fps
flags.description: expected frame rate

outputs: jobs/<job>/verify/: one still per check point, contact.png, report.md

commands.name: check
commands.summary: Lint a job's captions and cut against the edit rules; with no job, self-test the repo (examples, recipes, menu, showcase, this contract).

flags.name: warn-only
flags.description: print problems, never fail

failures: exit 1 with each error listed (em dashes, hype words, unknown entrance, transition, sound or finish, contract drift)

commands.name: smoke
commands.summary: End-to-end test on synthetic clips in a temp folder. Several minutes, no footage, keys or network.

flags.name: whisper
flags.description: also run a tiny Whisper model

flags.name: effects
flags.description: include the effects pass

flags.name: keep
flags.description: keep the temp work folder

failures: prints FAIL with the failing step and exits 1

commands.name: contract
commands.summary: Check contract.json against the real CLIs (also part of npm run check).

commands.name: fx
commands.summary: Optional effects pass over a finished reel (captions stay on top), or over any video.

positional.name: video
positional.description: direct mode: draw effects over this video (captions included)

flags.name: name
flags.description: job in jobs/ (job mode)

flags.name: plan
flags.description: fx.json plan (required unless --list)

flags.name: list
flags.description: print the effects catalog, grouped by moment

flags.name: still
flags.description: seconds to render as check frames instead of a video

flags.name: out
flags.description: direct mode output

flags.name: captions
flags.description: force captions on or off for every effect

flags.name: matte
flags.description: same as --mask

flags.name: allow-demo-copy
flags.description: fill neutral [placeholders] for missing copy, for a quick look only

flags.name: pill
flags.description: turn on the upstream Edited by pill on glass-widgets

flags.name: sfx
flags.description: no pack sounds

flags.name: no-sfx
flags.description: same as --sfx off

outputs: job mode: jobs/<job>/reel-fx-vN.mp4; with --still, frames in jobs/<job>/build/fx/
failures: Effects are not set up yet. Run: npm run effects:setup
Fix the plan first (effects that need your own copy)

commands.name: preset
commands.summary: List, show or save brand presets.

flags.name: show
flags.description: print one preset as JSON

flags.name: save
flags.description: save a preset with this name (needs --from)

flags.name: from
flags.description: job to save the preset from

commands.name: reelmd
commands.summary: Check, compile, export or package a Reel.md recipe.

subcommands.name: compile
outputs: recipe.cut.json and recipe.captions.json in --out (default: next to the recipe)

positional.name: job
positional.description: job name, build folder or cut.json

flags.name: out
flags.default: next to the recipe (compile) or stdout (export)

flags.name: name
flags.description: export: the recipe name

failures: REELMD FAIL with each problem listed

commands.name: teardown
commands.summary: Break a reference reel down into a Reel.md, a report and a contact sheet, to remake with your own clip.

positional.name: video
positional.description: a local video you have the rights to

flags.name: engine
flags.description: rea-video, or the built-in analyzer (used automatically when rea-video is missing)

flags.name: install
flags.description: pip-install rea-video into PYTHON first (about 216 MB of models on first use)

flags.name: model
flags.description: Whisper model for the built-in analyzer

flags.name: no-asr
flags.description: skip speech recognition

flags.name: no-ocr
flags.description: skip on-screen text recognition

flags.name: vlm
flags.description: rea-video: use its vision model pass

flags.name: reuse
flags.description: keep an earlier breakdown in the out folder and only redo the mapping

flags.name: url
flags.description: optional: one Instagram post or reel link instead of a file (needs instaloader; anonymous, no login, no bulk; you must have the rights)

outputs: teardown/<name>/Reel.md, teardown.md, contact.jpg, and videomd/ (rea-video) or fallback.json
commands.success: exit 0; then npm run reel -- --recipe teardown/<name>/Reel.md --clip <your clip>
failures: a URL as the positional argument is refused (download it yourself where you have the rights)
rea-video not found: falls back to the built-in analyzer with a note
